g.text: The four layers of an AI product
one question per layer; a chatbot answers, an agent acts on your behalf (OBO), in a cloud or on your machine
where do I talk to it?
the same loop in both: the model asks,
a tool acts, the result goes back, again
the same in all three: the model runs on a provider's servers;
who sells and operates the inference sets the contract on your data
On your machine the agent acts as you: same credentials, same network; permissions are the only guardrail.
In a vendor's cloud it has a copy of the repository and only what it was given; it works while you are away.
